worldcombat.skill.bubblebeam.summary: Spits three slow bubbles that drift out along the aim one after another: each pops on the first entity or wall it touches and settles its damage on what it actually hits, splitting the move's whole power three ways. A foe actually hurt by a bubble is rolled at most once per string for the Speed drop and foam, sticking it and slowing it; turning the aim lays later bubbles on another line. Dense foam clings harder with bigger, slower bubbles; rapid bubbles go farther and faster with smaller bubbles.
worldcombat.skill.bubblebeam.use.0: Block a foe's sideways route with a string of slow bubbles and force it to go around
worldcombat.skill.bubblebeam.use.1: Stick to a fast foe and drag its Speed down
worldcombat.skill.bubblebeam.use.2: Leave a layer of clinging foam on the target
worldcombat.skill.bubblebeam.description: Each bubble settles its damage on whatever it actually hits first; the whole string of three totals %1$s special damage (split evenly on each hit). All three can be in the air at once and an untouched bubble keeps drifting on.
A bubble has a %1$s block hit radius, drifts at %2$s blocks/tick and reaches %3$s blocks with up to ±%4$s spread between the three; each pops on the first entity or wall it touches.

Each target is rolled at most once per string: a %1$s chance to lower its Speed by %2$s stage(s) as a stat stage that does not recover when the foam ends, and it is always left foamed for about %3$s. The roll only happens if a bubble actually damages it.
worldcombat.skill.bubblebeam.dense.on: Dense foam: cling chance +10%, up to 2 stages, foam duration x1.3, real bubble radius x1.25 and a slightly wider string; costs total power x0.82, speed x0.85, wind-up +2 ticks and cooldown +4 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.bubblebeam.dense.off: Rapid bubbles: total power x1.12, speed x1.12, range +2 blocks and smaller bubbles; costs cling chance -4% and foam duration x0.8.
worldcombat.skill.bubblebeam.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.bubblebeam.growth.0: From level %1$s the total power rises to %2$s and the bubble radius to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.bubblebeam.growth.1: From level %1$s the total power rises to %2$s, the cling chance to %3$s and the foam duration to %4$s.
On: cling chance +10%, up to 2 Speed stages, foam duration x1.3, real bubble radius x1.25 and a slightly wider string, for pinning a foe down; costs total power x0.82, speed x0.85, wind-up +2 ticks and cooldown +4 ticks. Off (rapid bubbles): total power x1.12, speed x1.12, range +2 blocks and smaller bubbles, at the cost of cling chance -4% and foam duration x0.8.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
On: a target moving quickly ranks higher so the foam slows it first; off: all targets score the same.
